screen_notes: The candidate is a FRESHER: reject jobs that are clearly for experienced people or say freshers cannot apply.

His TARGET role is a FastAPI / Python backend that integrates AI: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini), ML models served through APIs, AI-powered features in web apps. Give these the highest fit. Python backend / API roles and Python full-stack roles (HTML/CSS/JS) are also good.

Fresher SDE / software engineer roles are fine only if Python is one of the job's main languages. Reject roles whose day-to-day stack is another language (Java, Go, C#/.NET, Node.js, PHP ...) even when Python is listed as an option, and roles that need a specific other stack only (Salesforce, SAP, mobile, QA/testing).

Reject data engineering (Spark / Kafka / Flink pipelines), DevOps / cloud, pure frontend, and AI/ML or data-science roles that are only model training, research or analytics with no API / backend work.

His only backend framework is FastAPI. Reject jobs where Django or Flask is REQUIRED (must have / mandatory / strong or N years of Django/Flask) and FastAPI is not accepted. KEEP jobs that list FastAPI as an option (e.g. 'Django/Flask/FastAPI'), accept any Python framework, give Django/Flask only as examples, or call them nice-to-have.

Remote jobs: keep only if he can do them from Hyderabad, India - remote in India, or worldwide / APAC remote open to candidates in India. Reject remote jobs limited to the US / EU / UK or other countries, needing work authorization there, or needing relocation.
tailor_notes: - The candidate is a FRESHER (final-year student, graduating 2027). Never claim full-time experience; the Infosys Springboard role is an internship.
- Summary: fresher framing, max 45 words. Skills: 4-5 categories.
- Projects matter most: the 3 most relevant (prefer Priority: high), 2-3 bullets each, with the repo / live link from the master resume.
- Cover letter: fresher tone; mention availability - internships now, full-time from 2027 (pick what fits the job type).

- For AI / LLM / ML jobs, lead with FastAPI + ML-model integration and the FitPulse ML work. Mention the AI Interview Platform only as ongoing / in design (planned FastAPI + OpenAI/Gemini) - never as finished, and never list OpenAI/Gemini/LLM as skills he has shipped.
